{
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Azithromycin 250 mg swallow it daily for 3 more days. This is an antibiotic that treats certain bacterial infections.",
          "sources": ["p1:L8", "drug:azithromycin", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Acetaminophen 650 mg swallow it every 6 hours only when you need it for fever or pain. Do not take more than 3,000 mg in a day. This is a pain reliever and fever reducer.",
          "sources": ["p1:L9", "drug:acetaminophen", "term:PO", "term:q6h", "term:PRN"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Metformin ER 500 mg swallow it daily with dinner. This is a diabetes medicine that helps lower blood sugar when used with diet and exercise.",
          "sources": ["p1:L10", "drug:metformin", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Atorvastatin 10 mg swallow it every night at bedtime. This is a cholesterol medicine that lowers bad cholesterol and reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke.",
          "sources": ["p1:L11", "drug:atorvastatin", "term:PO", "term:QHS"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Aspirin 81 mg swallow it daily. This is a pain reliever that also helps prevent blood clots.",
          "sources": ["p1:L12", "drug:aspirin", "term:PO"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "med_schedule": [
